title: Biking through Barcelona
text: Went on a study abroad trip with my school back in May and had a great time biking through the city of Barcelona with Alvaro. He was very knowledgeable about the historical roots of the architecture and religious history. My key highlights were visiting the Sagrada Familia and biking alongside of the beach.

title: Highly Recommend- Good Way to See City
text: Angie was very knowledgeable! Great way to see the city in a short period of time. Very casual bike ride but you see a whole lot!
